title: Khaake shifa pe
body:
khaak e shifa pe farz jo sajda hai ay hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya tere wajood ko maanegi ek din
kya teri manzilat hai ye jaanegi ek din
shayad ke teri qabr bhi kaaba hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere lahoo ka ek ek khatra hai la jawab
milti nahi jahan mein teri koi bhi misaal
ye martaba ke maa teri zehra hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil pe sar patakta hai maujaon ka ikhtiyar
jaise ke roye asghar e baysheer ko rabab
pyasa lab e furaat pe kunba hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
tune lahoo diya to bacha deen e mustafa
maqrooz tere hogaye ye saare ambiya
dunya mein har jagah tera charcha hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ko jhukaye chalta hai kaaton pe wo magar
gardan mein tauq paon mein bedi lahoo jigar
saabir teri tarha tera beta hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab hai sar barehna agar tu hai be-kafan
taqdeerein uski ban gayi ye zulm ki rasan
zainab ke dil pe ek hi sadma hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar nange dekh aayi hai bazaar e shaam tak
qaidi ki tarha pahunchi hai darbar e shaam tak
ye imtehan e zapt bhi kaisa hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye mazhar abidi ka aqeeda bhi hai bata
jayega tere rauze pe humraah kamran
dil mein ye aarzoo tha padna hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
author: Mazhar Abidi
